# Project
For my final project, I plan to create an interactive website called Car Stats Explorer that compares different cars to help people find the best vehicle for their budget and preferences. I will use the Car Features and MSRP dataset to explore the relationships between vehicle price, horsepower, fuel etconomy, model year, and manufacturer. I am especially interested in finding out whether more expensive cars generally have more horsepower and which cars provide the most horsepower for their price. I plan to use scatterplots, bar charts, and interactive filters to compare vehicles and identify trends in the data. My goal is to make a project that uses statistics to help people make more informed decisions when choosing a car. 

# Highest-Horsepower Car by Brand

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(tidyverse))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(plotly))

cars <- read_csv(
  "https://gist.githubusercontent.com/dvinubius/33486dad2dc86319f0a06ffdb1d4f34f/raw/",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

top_cars_by_brand <- cars |>
  filter(
    !is.na(Make), !is.na(Model), !is.na(Year),
    !is.na(`Engine HP`), `Engine HP` > 0,
    !is.na(MSRP), MSRP > 0
  ) |>
  group_by(Make, Model, Year) |>
  arrange(desc(`Engine HP`), desc(MSRP), .by_group = TRUE) |>
  slice_head(n = 1) |>
  ungroup() |>
  group_by(Make) |>
  arrange(desc(`Engine HP`), desc(Year), Model, .by_group = TRUE) |>
  slice_head(n = 3) |>
  ungroup() |>
  group_by(Make) |>
  mutate(hp_rank = row_number()) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    car = paste(Year, Model),
    label = paste0(`Engine HP`, " HP | ", scales::dollar(MSRP))
  )

brands <- sort(unique(top_cars_by_brand$Make))
first_brand <- brands[[1]]
bar_colors <- c("#2E8B57", "#8A2BE2", "#1E90FF")

brand_chart <- plot_ly()

for (brand in brands) {
  brand_cars <- top_cars_by_brand |>
    filter(Make == brand) |>
    arrange(`Engine HP`)

  brand_chart <- brand_chart |>
    add_trace(
      data = brand_cars,
      x = ~`Engine HP`,
      y = ~forcats::fct_reorder(car, `Engine HP`),
      text = ~label,
      hovertemplate = "%{y}<br>%{x} HP<br>Price: %{customdata}<extra></extra>",
      customdata = ~scales::dollar(MSRP),
      type = "bar",
      orientation = "h",
      textposition = "outside",
      cliponaxis = FALSE,
      marker = list(color = bar_colors[brand_cars$hp_rank]),
      visible = brand == first_brand,
      name = brand
    )
}

brand_buttons <- lapply(brands, \(brand) {
  list(
    label = brand,
    method = "restyle",
    args = list(list(visible = brands == brand))
  )
})

brand_chart |>
  layout(
    title = list(text = "Top 3 cars by horsepower"),
    xaxis = list(title = "Engine horsepower", rangemode = "tozero"),
    yaxis = list(title = ""),
    updatemenus = list(list(
      type = "dropdown",
      direction = "down",
      x = 0,
      y = 1.18,
      xanchor = "left",
      yanchor = "top",
      buttons = brand_buttons
    )),
    annotations = list(list(
      text = "Select a car brand:",
      x = 0,
      y = 1.27,
      xref = "paper",
      yref = "paper",
      xanchor = "left",
      yanchor = "top",
      showarrow = FALSE
    )),
    margin = list(l = 110, t = 100, r = 100, b = 60)
  ) |>
  config(displayModeBar = FALSE)
```

## Highest-Horsepower Car for Every Brand

```{r}
#| fig-height: 16
brand_top_cars <- cars |>
  filter(!is.na(Make), !is.na(Model), !is.na(Year), !is.na(`Engine HP`), `Engine HP` > 0) |>
  group_by(Make, Model, Year) |>
  arrange(desc(`Engine HP`), .by_group = TRUE) |>
  slice_head(n = 1) |>
  ungroup() |>
  group_by(Make) |>
  arrange(desc(`Engine HP`), desc(Year), Model, .by_group = TRUE) |>
  slice_head(n = 1) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(car = paste(Make, Model, sep = " — "))

ggplot(
  brand_top_cars,
  aes(x = `Engine HP`, y = forcats::fct_reorder(car, `Engine HP`), fill = `Engine HP`)
) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = `Engine HP`), hjust = -0.25, size = 2.8) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = c("#2E8B57", "#8A2BE2", "#1E90FF"),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Highest-horsepower car for each brand",
    x = "Engine horsepower",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Each bar shows the single highest-horsepower car listed for that brand."
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7))
```
